# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1534
**EDP: fail closed for unlisted backlog scopes when DB mode is on**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Unlisted scopes silently stay file-authoritative when PF_BACKLOG_DB=on. -> DB mode fail-closed for unlisted scopes; explicit off for legacy file mode.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1534
  prior_decisions : ['BI-PF-1531 DB authority default', 'unlisted scopes stay file mode today']
  existing_path   : ['core/backlog._db_for warns and returns false', 'core/id_allocator delegates to backlog']
  assumptions     : ['Only explicit PF_BACKLOG_DB=off uses files', 'Required scopes remain product_forge and ProductForge-Dashboard']
  divergences     : ['Silent file fallback for unlisted scopes']
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  API CHECK | aligned | No API shape change | Keep runtime guard only
  AC CHECK | aligned | Four fail-closed ACs | Test all paths
  LANGUAGE CHECK | aligned | Existing Python edits only; no new module | Keep DB logic in Go
  TENANT/RLS CHECK | aligned | Unlisted tenant fails before DB/file access | Fail closed

## Current stage
**complete**

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=83b1344fcea7)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 6 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 0 / MINOR 4 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 6; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MINOR | Delta `design_pack.observability` defers cross-process metrics/alerting to an unnamed "follow-up item" with no owner/ID; guardrail 10/15 expects at least tracked alert ownership for fail-closed events emitted by workers/edpsvc. | ACTIONED | Synced in BI-PF-1534 spec; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md. |
| 2 | MINOR | AC-4 verification is fragmented across four artifacts with no stated authority: FR-4 `verification` = runbook, `design_pack.coverage` AC-4 `tests` = `pytest -k ac4`, `design_pack.test_matrix` AC-4 = runbook only, `ac_evidence.AC-4` = `AC-4.md`; unclear which one gates AC-4. | ACTIONED | Synced in BI-PF-1534 spec; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md. |
| 3 | MINOR | `design_pack.coverage` AC-4 lists `entrypoint: core/backlog.py` and `call_sites` in core even though `runtime_capability: false` (runbook adapter), so traceability points runtime code at a non-runtime AC. | ACTIONED | Synced in BI-PF-1534 spec; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md. |
| 4 | MINOR | Delta `functional_spec.traceability` AC-4 `evidence` still lists only `test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_backlog_db_cutover.py` while its `test` row points at `engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md`; the evidence array was not synced with the corrected test pointer. | ACTIONED | Synced in BI-PF-1534 spec; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md. |
| 5 | NIT | Delta `design_pack.code_guidelines` cites FastAPI/REST API guidelines although the spec marks `api` N/A and API changes are out of scope for this delta; harmless but signals applicability noise. | ACTIONED | Synced in BI-PF-1534 spec; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md. |
| 6 | NIT | `config_contract.PF_BACKLOG_DB_SCOPES.startup_validation` is "precheck + first operation" while `empty_behavior` is "fail when on"; deferring to first operation means an unlisted/empty list fails only at runtime, not at startup precheck — worth an explicit note in the runbook. | ACTIONED | Synced in BI-PF-1534 spec; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/operator-recovery.md. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta is substantively sound: prior findings are addressed (AC-2 `runtime_capability` now true, `-k acN` selectors added, `PF_BACKLOG_DB_SCOPES` now carries `BACKLOG_DB_SCOPE_UNLISTED`, AC-4 runbook pointer added), and the 1:1 AC/FR mapping plus on/dual/shadow/off operation matrix satisfy mode completeness and fail-closed intent.
  Top risks: AC-4's proof is split across runbook/pytest/evidence artifacts without an authority, and deferred cross-process alerting leaves worker-side fail-closed events under-observable until a tracked follow-up exists.
  No blocker; proceed once the AC-4 evidence authority and the observability deferral tracking are tightened in the design rows.
